narr: A warm front lifted north into Pennsylvania during the day and became stalled during the early evening across the northeastern part of the Commonwealth. Thunderstorms became aligned along the Wyoming Valley, and extended off to the east into the Lackawaxen Valley during the evening. Rainfall amounts between 2 to 3 inches fell in a very short amount of time over urban and moderately populated rural areas leading to several road closures, overtopped bridges and small stream flash flooding.
ev: Law enforcement reported water flowing through a residence in this area.
Main Street between New Street and Pennsylvania Avenue was closed with 5 feet of moving water covering the roadway.
It was reported that multiple cars were stranded in several feet of water.
Several bridges were flooded and roads closed due to rapid moving water.
